home_text: From a basic block or a blank sheet: draft, grade, choose the lay, gaps and stripes, then nest and cut.
confirm_restart: Start a new style? The current style on this computer is cleared. Save the style file first if you need it.
confirm_replace: Replace the current pattern? Your drawing on this style is replaced by the new start. Save the style file first if you need it.
storage_full: This browser could not keep the style. Save the style file now.
step_style_hint: Name the style, choose sizes and a starting block.
step_grade_hint: Size chart, all sizes stacked, seam checks.
step_lay_hint: Fabric width, spread, face, nap, plies and ratio.
step_gaps_hint: Space between pieces and at the edges.
step_marker_hint: Nest the pieces and check the marker.
step_cut_hint: Files and the next steps on the cutting floor.
step_style_lead: Give the style a name, choose the sizes, then start from a basic block or a blank sheet.
step_pattern_lead: Choose a tool on the left. Drag points and curve handles. Type exact lengths. Select a piece to set its quantity, fabric and seam allowance.
step_grade_lead: Edit the size chart. Every size is drawn again from it. Check that seams that sew together are the same length.
step_lay_lead: Tell BETA how the fabric is laid on the table and how many garments of each size go in one marker.
step_gaps_lead: Space between pieces, at the fabric edges and at both ends of the lay. The picture is drawn to scale.
step_stripes_lead: For striped or checked fabric: enter the repeat and choose the points that must meet at the seams.
step_marker_lead: BETA nests the pieces with your settings and checks every rule. Stop at any time to keep the best marker so far.
step_cut_lead: Print or export the files and send the marker to the cut plan and the spreading table.
why_no_name: Give the style a name first.
why_no_start: Choose a basic block or a blank sheet first.
why_no_piece: Make at least one closed piece first.
why_lay_width: Enter a fabric width between 20 cm and 4 m.
why_lay_plies: Check the plies. Folded, tube and face-to-face lays need an even number.
why_lay_ratio: Put at least one garment in the marker.
why_repeat: Check the stripe or check repeat.
why_busy: Wait for the marker search to finish, or press Stop.
buyer_free_hint: Only the name is needed. Buyer and order details stay in your own system.
size_range_hint: These are example body measurements. Put your buyer's chart in the Grade step.
start_from_hint: A block is a basic pattern made from the size chart. You can change every line after.
blank_ready: Blank sheet is ready. Draw a shape and close it to make a piece.
tool_select_help: Select and drag points, curve handles and pieces.
tool_line_help: Draw straight lines. Close the shape to make a piece.
tool_curve_help: Draw a curve, then drag its two handles.
tool_arc_help: Draw an arc: centre, start, end.
tool_offset_help: Parallel copy of a line or curve, or a copy of a piece grown or shrunk by a distance.
tool_mirror_help: Make a mirrored copy of a piece across a line.
tool_split_help: Cut a piece in two along a line.
tool_join_help: Join two pieces that share a seam.
tool_dart_help: Add a dart on an edge.
tool_pleat_help: Add a pleat along a line.
tool_notch_help: Add a notch on an edge.
tool_buttons_help: Add a row of buttons, buttonholes or drill holes.
tool_text_help: Add a label inside a piece.
tool_seam_help: Set the seam allowance of an edge.
tool_grain_help: Set the grain line of a piece.
tool_fold_help: Mark a straight edge as the fold.
tool_measure_help: Measure a line or the distance between two points.
hint_select_0: Click a point, line or piece. Drag points and curve handles. Shift adds to the selection. Drag on empty paper to box-select.
hint_point_0: Click to place a point. Snaps to points and the grid.
hint_line_1: Click the end point, or type the length and angle, then press Enter.
hint_line_2: Click the next point. Click the first point to close the shape and make a piece.
hint_line_3: Click the next point. Click the first point to close the shape and make a piece.
hint_curve_0: Click the start of the curve.
hint_curve_1: Click the end of the curve. Then drag the square handles to shape it.
hint_arc_0: Click the centre of the arc.
hint_arc_1: Click where the arc starts (this sets the radius).
hint_arc_2: Click where the arc ends. It turns anticlockwise; hold Shift to turn clockwise.
hint_offset_0: Click a line or curve for a parallel copy, or click inside a piece to grow or shrink the whole piece.
hint_mirror_1: Click the first point of the mirror line.
hint_mirror_2: Click the second point of the mirror line.
hint_split_1: Click where the cut line starts.
hint_split_2: Click where the cut line ends.
hint_dart_0: Click on an edge where the dart opens.
hint_pleat_0: Click the piece for the pleat.
hint_pleat_1: Click where the pleat line starts.
hint_pleat_2: Click where the pleat line ends.
hint_notch_0: Click on an edge to add a notch.
hint_drill_0: Click inside a piece to add a drill hole.
hint_buttons_0: Click where the first button goes.
hint_buttons_1: Click where the last button goes.
hint_text_0: Click inside a piece to place a label.
hint_seam_0: Click an edge to set its seam allowance.
hint_grain_1: Click the start of the grain line.
hint_grain_2: Click the end of the grain line.
hint_fold_0: Click a straight edge to mark it as the fold.
hint_measure_0: Click a line or curve for its length, or click two points.
canvas_label: Pattern drawing. Tool keys: V select, P point, L line, C curve, A arc. Arrow keys move the selected points by 1 mm, with Shift 10 mm. Delete removes. Plus, minus and 0 zoom. Esc cancels.
arrange_hint: Lay the pieces side by side on the sheet
blank_text: Draw lines and close the shape to make a piece, or start with a rectangle piece.
pieces_hint: Set how many of each piece to cut, left and right pairs, and the fabric.
no_pieces: No pieces yet. Close a shape with the Line tool.
pair_long: Cut as left and right pair
tip_select: Click a piece to see its quantity, fabric and seam allowance.
tip_draw: Choose a tool on the left. Each tool shows what to do next under the drawing.
tip_type: While drawing a line, type the length and press Enter.
tip_keys: Keys: V P L C A, Delete, Ctrl+Z, Esc.
multi_hint: Arrow keys move the selected points together. Delete removes them.
make_piece: Make a piece from these lines
name: Name
point_fixed: Fixed point. X and Y are for size {size}; other sizes keep their grading.
point_built: Built from other points ({how}). It moves with them.
curve_hint: Drag the two square handles to change the curve.
err_small: This is too small. Click further away.
err_pick_edge: Click on the edge of a piece.
err_fold_straight: A fold must be a straight edge.
err_angle: Enter the angle in degrees, for example 90.
err_name: Use a name that starts with a letter, with letters, numbers, dots or underscores.
err_not_loop: These lines do not close into one shape. Check that each line starts where the last one ends.
err_size_name: Enter a new size name (up to 12 characters).
err_edges: Enter edge numbers, for example 2 or 2,3.
err_file_size: Choose a file smaller than 20 MB.
done_curve: Curve added. Drag its handles to shape it.
done_piece: Piece made. Set its quantity and seam allowance on the right.
done_free: This point is now free to move.
size_chart_hint: Change a value and every size is drawn again from the chart.
chart_empty: No measurements yet. A blank sheet uses only the sizes.
size_added: Size {size} added one step after the last size.
confirm_preset: Replace the size chart with sizes {sizes}?
chart_updated: Size chart updated. All sizes drawn again.
nest_aria: All sizes of {piece} stacked on one point
pick_point_for_rule: To move one point by hand in each size, click a point on the drawing.
rule_hint: Movement from the base size. A rule makes this piece use the base shape plus the moves for every ruled point.
seam_caption: Difference in length between seams that sew together (should be close to 0)
no_seam_checks: No seam checks yet. Add one below.
edges_hint: Edge numbers are in the piece details on the Pattern step (Seam allowance table).
width_too_small: This is narrower than 20 cm. Check the number and the unit.
width_too_large: This is wider than 4 m. Check the number and the unit.
folded_width_hint: For folded or tube fabric, enter the width as it lies on the table (half the open width).
fabric_for_marker_hint: This style uses more than one fabric. Each marker is for one fabric. Make one marker per fabric.
face_hint: Face to face gives left and right pieces from one marker.
allow_flip: Fabric has no face side: pieces may be turned over
plies_even: Fabric layers on the table. This lay cuts two layers together, so use an even number.
ratio_caption: Garments of each size in one marker
lay_summary: One marker holds {garments} garments. With {plies} plies one lay cuts {total} garments.
gaps_hint: The gap at a fold edge is always zero. Buffer adds space around one piece. A fusing block cuts a rectangle around the piece first.
gaps_preview_aria: Fabric with two pieces: gap between pieces {gap}, edge gap {edge}, end allowance {end} at each end.
gaps_preview_hint: Shaded ends are the end allowance. Dashed shapes are buffers and fusing blocks.
repeat_tolerance: Enter a tolerance of 0 or more.
overlay_pieces_aria: Pieces of the base size with the stripes drawn over them
overlay_pieces_hint: Grain runs up the page. This shows how the stripes cross each piece before nesting.
match_hint: Tap a point on piece A, then the point on piece B that must meet it at the seam (for example the side seam at the hem).
match_pick_a: Step 1: tap a point on piece A.
match_pick_b: Step 2: tap the point on piece B that meets {point}.
stopping: Stopping. The best marker so far is kept.
nest_none: No marker was found in the time. Try a longer search or check the fabric width.
marker_stale: Settings changed after this marker was made. Make the marker again to use them.
practice_marker: Practice layout · not a real marker. Do not cut from it.
browser_no_match: Some match points are not matched. Make the marker again with a longer search, or check the repeat and the match points.
no_marker_text: Choose a search time and press Make marker.
open_editor_hint: Move pieces by hand, lock, re-nest, and all export files.
files_pattern_hint: Print the pattern at 100% and check the test square. DXF-AAMA has all sizes.
stripe_guides: Draw stripe guide lines on the marker (not cut lines)
next_in_cutting_room_hint: The marker goes to the next screen directly. No file is needed.
edited_used: The edited marker is now the style's marker.
engine_failed_hint: Reload the page. If it still fails, this browser may block WebAssembly: use a current Chrome, Edge or Firefox, or the desktop app.
how_style_1: Type a style name. Only the name is needed.
how_style_2: Untick the sizes you do not make.
how_style_3: Pick a basic block or a blank sheet. You can change every line later.
how_pattern_1: Choose a tool on the left. The line under the drawing says what to click next.
how_pattern_2: Drag points and curve handles. While drawing, type a length and press Enter.
how_pattern_3: Click a piece to set its quantity, fabric and seam allowance. Ctrl+Z undoes.
how_grade_1: Change a body measurement in the chart. Every size is drawn again.
how_grade_2: The drawing stacks all sizes. Click a corner point to move it by hand in each size.
how_grade_3: Seam checks show if seams that sew together have the same length in every size.
how_lay_1: Enter the fabric width as it lies on the table.
how_lay_2: Choose open, folded or tube, then the face and the nap.
how_lay_3: Set the plies and how many garments of each size go in one marker.
how_gaps_1: Set the gap between pieces and at the fabric edges.
how_gaps_2: In the table, add extra space around one piece or a fusing block.
how_gaps_3: The picture is drawn to scale, so you can see each gap.
how_stripes_1: Plain fabric? Choose Plain and go to the next step.
how_stripes_2: For stripes or checks, enter the repeat: the distance from one stripe to the next.
how_stripes_3: Tap a point on piece A, then the point on piece B that must meet it. After the marker, each pair shows Matched or how many mm it is off.
how_marker_1: Choose a search time and press Make marker. Stop at any time to keep the best so far.
how_marker_2: Stripes and match points are drawn on the marker. Green rings match. Red rings are off.
how_marker_3: To change a setting, tap a chip at the top, then make the marker again.
how_cut_1: Print the pattern at 100% and measure the test square.
how_cut_2: Save the marker file for your plotter or cutter.
how_cut_3: Send the marker to the cut plan, the spreading sheet or bundles.
marker_working_text: The best marker so far appears here after the first search round, then improves while the search runs. Stop keeps it.
match_check_hint: Make the marker in the next step. Each pair then shows Matched, or how many mm it is off.
match_summary: Last marker: {ok} matched, {off} off, {none} not in the marker (of {total}).
match_summary_stale: Settings changed after the last marker. Make the marker again to check the pairs.
nest_failed: The marker could not be made.
nest_failed_hint: Check the fabric width, the gaps and the stripe repeat, then try again. A piece wider than the fabric cannot be placed.
no_matches_hint: Tap a point on piece A above, then the point on piece B that must meet it. Without pairs, the stripes are drawn but not matched.
engine_failed_dev: For developers: build the Pattern WASM (npm run build:pattern-wasm -w @beta/marker-wasm), then reload.
preview_empty: The picture shows when the pattern has at least one closed piece.
nest_empty: This piece has no outline in these sizes yet.
err_pick_offset: Click on a line or curve, or inside a piece.
done_offset_path: Parallel copy made. It follows the original line in every size.
linked_piece: Linked piece, made from {source}. It is drawn again from the source in every size. Check the seam allowance, marks and grain before cutting.
err_engine_old: This engine version cannot do that yet. Update BETA to use it.
parallel_hint: Follows {source} in every size. To change its shape, change {source}.
tool_extend_help: Copy of a straight line that ends exactly on another line (longer or shorter).
hint_extend_0: Click a straight line near the end you want to move.
hint_extend_1: Now click the line it should meet.
err_pick_other_line: Click a different straight line to meet.
done_extend: Line copy made. It ends on the other line in every size.
marker_live_aria: Best marker so far: {m} {u} long, {e}% efficiency. The search is still running.
live_best: Searching · best marker so far shown
marker_keys: Wheel or + − to zoom · drag or arrows to move · 0 shows all · point at or tap a piece for its details
plies_whole: Enter a whole number of plies, 1 or more.
plies_max: Most tables take up to {max} plies. Enter 1 to {max}.
plies_even_error: Folded, tube and face-to-face lays cut two layers together: use an even number of plies.
surplus_note: This marker cuts {n} pieces that no garment uses (a folded or tube lay can waste a layer). Try an open lay, or allow pieces to be turned over if the fabric has no face side.
review_title: Seam checks need review after a change of pieces
spec_unavailable: No measurement spec for this pattern yet
spec_all_ok: All measured values with a target are within tolerance
spec_caption: Finished measurements in {unit} (seam allowance not included). "design" = no body target.
spec_caption_grade: Change from the size before, in {unit}
lay_passes: {plies} plies = {passes} passes from the roll (folded or tube: 2 plies per pass).
pass_tip: 1 pass = one length from the roll; folded or tube = 2 plies.
yield_tip: Fabric that ends up in garments, both layers counted.
footprint_tip: Table area the pieces cover, including copies no garment uses.
fold_edge_note: This order is limited by the fold length, not by search time. Try more garments per marker (even counts per size), a tube, or an open lay.
